title: C++: Event Loop (Simulated)
description: Simulate an event loop with timer events and callbacks.

steps.title: Event Loop
steps.description: Create an EventLoop class with post(function) to queue callbacks and run() to process them. Implement setTimeout(fn, delay) that schedules a callback after a simulated delay using a priority queue.
hints: struct TimerEvent { int time; function<void()> cb; bool operator>(...) };
